title: Placeholder: evidence-based question
claimTopic: Placeholder: whether partial reinforcement makes behavior last longer.

study.introduction: Placeholder introduction: researchers asked whether the schedule of reinforcement changes persistence.
study.participants: Placeholder participants: 60 volunteers, randomly assigned to two groups. All gave informed consent and were debriefed.
study.method: Placeholder method: each group played a game on a different schedule; persistence was the number of tries after rewards stopped.
study.results: Placeholder results: the variable-ratio group kept trying longer.
